title: Article. Priced to Outperform Perfection: The Home Depot Circa 1999
summary:
One of the most common risks with the successful business is simple. This is a key question for investors who may have counted on many more years of growth
in order for the company to generate enough earnings to rationalize a higher valuation. Instead of starting with the question, with the risk of not achieving 1900 stores, start with
with the return of what you'd get if they did.
